mechanism: Concurrent use of topical corticosteroids with retinoids increases skin irritation, erythema, and potential for dermal atrophy; fluticasone may mask tretinoin efficacy and increase local adverse effects.
action: Avoid concurrent topical application on the same skin areas; if co-treatment is necessary, apply at different times (e.g., tretinoin at night, fluticasone in morning) and monitor for increased irritation, peeling, and skin barrier compromise.
